rubric.coherence: 2 = starts AND ends at a sentence/heading boundary (self-contained idea); 1 = one boundary broken; 0 = both boundaries broken or a subjectless fragment. 10 fixed positions = opening span of printed pages 7-16 (chosen before reading scores).
rubric.grounding: 2 = top-3 has enough evidence to answer and trace the source; 1 = has related evidence but missing the specific answer/condition; 0 = no relevant evidence. 5 test questions, judged manually.
rubric.metadata: Per test-question top-3 record: verify source, page, chapter, section against the deterministic section map and the source text.

coherence.note: Start-boundary breaks at pages 9, 10, 12, 15 are inherited page-break/table continuations (identical for all strategies). The systematic difference is the END boundary: A (fixed 500-char) cuts mid-word on every page; B/C end on sentence boundaries.
